abstracts.abstract: Includes certain violations involving physical, psychological, or emotional harm to a child as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail.

bill.title: Includes certain violations involving children as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail

posted_text:
💰 Criminal Justice & Policing
NY A11713 — Could You Be Released on Own Recognizance in Certain Cases

New York could expand the circumstances where a judge releases someone accused of a crime while they await trial. This bill changes how the courts handle bail for specific offenses, particularly those involving harm to people or property, or crimes against children. ...
